key_finding.label: DERIVED
key_finding.claim: the published L10.3 cross-signature accuracy 0.5611 is a routing statistic, not a composition statistic
key_finding.interpretation: retrieval is perfect once the bank is resolved; the whole number is bank selection, and the selection is a deterministic function of task/bank index identical across seeds, i.e. allocation-order weight mass rather than a compositional capability
key_finding.effect_on_l10_record: none; L10.3 and L10.6 reported the routing rate and the 0.0-1.0 per-task spread honestly, L11.1 adds the decomposition and the cross-seed invariance
effect_on_l11_design: composition measured with unbalanced mixtures CROSS21/CROSS31 where the rule predicts a unique bank
1:1 mixture demoted to AMBIG11 tie-break compliance with no accuracy claim
routing and retrieval always reported separately (Comp, Read)
primary comparison against a measured null, never an absolute floor

definition.statement: resolve a cue built from features of two or more training signatures, in a feature-count ratio absent from training, to the bank prescribed by the pre-declared R-majority rule, on every task, seed and allocation order, and retrieve correctly from that bank
definition.declared_rule: R-majority: bank owning the group with most features; ties -> lowest bank index
cannot_establish: within-bank context modulation (no such mechanism exists)
generalization beyond two-signature cues at T=3,K=3
distinguishing R-majority from any other rule that predicts identical resolutions in a two-feature space

critical_gaps: selected_slot exists in CCResult but is never written - the L10.4 anomaly is unattributable for exactly this reason
cue_features / cue_category absent - a mixed cue is indistinguishable from a correct one per trial
intended_bank absent - no record of what a declared rule prescribes
bank_score_margin absent - near-ties indistinguishable from decisive errors
run_id / protocol_sha256 / model_hash absent - provenance only in directory names
instrumentation.non_interference_standard: per-trial byte comparison of the 17 projected L10 columns across paired on/off runs, plus aggregate equality as a secondary condition; aggregate equality alone is explicitly rejected as evidence

prototype_checks.expectation_correction_recorded: an initially over-strict rule (nullable field rejected) was found by the self-test and corrected, not hidden
prototype_checks.does_not_prove: that the C++ writer works; test T7 is unexecuted

criteria_candidate.L11-B: MixAcc(A2,t) - Null(t) >= 0.50 on >=2 of 3 tasks, every seed
criteria_candidate.L11-C: no (seed,task) cell in A2 or A3 below 0.50

acceptance_protocol.new_criterion_justification: L11-G follows directly from the key finding: a rule that only tracks allocation order must not pass

statistical_character.wording_rule: a pass is 'consistent with >=0.90 at n=120', never '>=0.90 established'

phase1_affinity.diagnosis: compiles to failure at DWORD_PTR on Linux; a type alias alone is insufficient because Case C calls GetProcessAffinityMask outside any platform guard
phase1_affinity.verified_by: g++ -fsyntax-only on the unmodified file and on a patched /tmp copy (repository file not modified)
phase1_affinity.portable_section: Cases A and B, deterministic 64-bit mask enumeration regression
phase1_affinity.windows_only_section: Case C, live Win32 API agreement, 3 direct CHECKs plus a per-CPU loop
phase1_affinity.defect_location: the test file, not the library

inherited_not_rerun.basis: no source changed in L11.1; expectation, not measurement

owner_decisions_required.subject: test_phase1_affinity disposition
owner_decisions_required.recommended: port: guard Case C with #ifdef _WIN32 and use a portable mask type
alternatives: declare Windows-only and exclude from the Linux gate

owner_decisions_required.subject: authorise additive default-off instrumentation in l10_validation_harness.cpp

limitations: defines a capability, demonstrates nothing about the system
definition scoped to a two-signature toy space and cannot distinguish R-majority from other rules with identical predictions there
seeds 7 and 42 held out from L11 design only, not from all prior exposure
instrumentation feasibility proven in Python over existing CSVs, not in the C++ writer
